name: The Card Sharp
palette: Dominant black and charcoal with polished gold accents and warm candlelight; deep card-table green felt and burgundy only as small accents.
character: THE CARD SHARP: a sly, elegant woman gambler in a dark green waistcoat, white shirt with rolled sleeves and a wide-brimmed black hat with a gold band; golden rings, a confident half-smile, playing cards fanned between her fingers. The playing cards she uses are plain-backed with gold edges and show only simple suit symbols, never readable text.
icon_subject: the Card Sharp's face under her wide-brimmed hat with a gold band, front view
portrait: full portrait of the Card Sharp leaning on a green-felt card table, fanning a hand of cards, in a smoky candlelit gambling den
banner: The Card Sharp standing at the foot of a dark spire, flicking a single glowing card into the air

overrides.joker: a mischievous jester card spirit bursting out of a plain gold-edged playing card in a swirl of colour
overrides.table_power: a round green-felt card table seen from above with five face-down cards
overrides.card_shark_power: a sleek grey shark fin cutting through a stack of playing cards
overrides.marked_deck: a worn deck of playing cards with tiny gold pinpricks on the back, tied with a red ribbon
overrides.royal_flush: the Card Sharp throwing five glowing golden cards that explode into a wave of light across a horde of monsters
overrides.showboat: the Card Sharp spinning on her heel, a ring of razor-sharp playing cards whirling around her
overrides.fifty_two_pickup: an entire deck of playing cards bursting into the air like shrapnel around a startled monster
overrides.strike_sharp: Close-up of a slim black-gloved hand with a gold ring entering from the lower left edge, gripping a gold-edged playing card like a blade, the card's cream face showing one big black spade, slashing diagonally up to the right with a sharp gleam on the card's edge. Background: deep crimson with darker black angular streaks.
